messages:
sara: Getting alert from auth-monitor: sudden auth latency + user lockouts in EU region. Support seeing a handful of users reporting repeated MFA pushes. Noticed increased 302s against our SSO endpoint. @jamie can you take on-call?

jamie: on it. pulling logs now. any user samples? alex from support?

alex: reported from three customers at 08:12 UTC. IDs: user_038, user_112, user_7. They said MFA push showed, then immediately another, several times.

sso-alert-bot: [ALERT] 1739998879 - auth_latency_region=eu-west increased 5x; failed_auth_rate +18% in last 3m. See /alerts/1739998879

jamie: grabbing auth logs. initial grep shows repeated state=challenge events followed by immediate re-initiate from same session id. pattern: session_id rotates then push re-sent.

leo: could be our session stitcher re-issuing auth when backend errors out. I'm checking the sso proxy timeout traces. Also verifying KMS logs for signature failures.

sara: good call. if it's a KMS issue that could trigger reauth attempts. leo, any errors in kms-client?

leo: quick grep: no kms-decrypt errors. but I do see intermittent 502 from idp-proxy to auth-service at 08:11:35 - 08:13:00. snippet:
```
08:11:36 idp-proxy -> auth-service 502 read timeout session=xxxx
08:11:36 auth-service retries forward session=xxxx
08:11:36 idp-proxy sends new auth request session=yyyy
08:11:36 mfa-push sent for session=xxxx
08:11:37 mfa-push sent for session=yyyy
```

natalie: that would explain double pushes -> user sees multiple prompts -> starts hitting deny -> account locks after N attempts. We should contain before more customers hit lockout.

jamie: containment plan: 1) throttle MFA pushes per principal for 10m via emergency policy; 2) temporarily increase lockout threshold for affected tenants to avoid cascade; 3) reroute auth traffic away from the flaky idp-proxy node pool.

sara: agree. alex can we apply temp policy change and notify affected customers? keep messaging minimal.

alex: on it. drafting short note: "We're seeing repeated MFA prompts in eu-west for a subset of users; we've applied a temporary mitigation and are investigating. You may see one-off prompts; no credential compromise suspected."

leo: I've cordoned the two idp-proxy instances with high error rates and spun new ones in a different AZ. Routing change in progress (ngw update).

sso-alert-bot: [ACTION] 1739998893 - emergency throttle policy applied: mfa_push_rate=1/min per user in eu-* for 10m.

jamie: raised lockout threshold for tenants T-43, T-89, T-101 to avoid auto-lockouts. Will revert after stabilization.

sara: exporting audit logs for all affected sessions and KMS access events for the interval 08:00-08:20. Need to rule out replay or token replays.

leo: export started -> link: /exports/auth-export-1739998898.csv

jamie: watching metrics. failed_auth_rate trending back to baseline after throttles and routing change. MFA push count down to normal.

natalie: next steps post-containment: 1) postmortem once we have full logs; 2) add a runbook step to detect idp-proxy 502->duplicate-push pattern; 3) add alert that correlates repeated push_count>1 per session_id within 5s.

alex: customer comms sent to affected accounts. no escalations yet.

sara: sounds good. assign owners: runbook update -> natalie, patch for proxy retry logic -> leo, follow-up with IdP vendor to confirm no upstream changes -> jamie.

jamie: I'll open an incident ticket and set the severity to Sev2 while we validate. ticket: INC-2024-4897

sara: nice catch everyone. quick retrospective note: we should also surface KMS signature latency spike correlated with idp-proxy errors if present. even if not causal, helps future triage.

leo: will add KMS latency graphs to the ticket and correlate with proxy logs.

sso-alert-bot: [RESOLVED] 1739998923 - alert resolved; metric back within baseline.

jamie: leaving follow-up tasks in INC-2024-4897. I'll mark this thread for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
